# Purpose

<!-- State the report question, intended reader, downstream use, and source-data version. -->


<!-- A standardised commercial CPUE index for {{SPECIES_NAME}} from logbook (or sales-note) records. Read index-wise's knowledge/cpue.md (the data) and knowledge/cpue-models.md (the models) before adapting it; the skills index-cpue-data and index-cpue-model walk through it. Logbook records are confidential: never show individual vessels or precise fishing positions, and keep the extract in the git-ignored data/source/cpue/. Do NOT hard-wrap prose. -->

# Data

<!-- Describe the source (ERS, aggregated logbooks, sales notes), its unit of observation, years, coverage and extraction date with inline R. -->

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here::here())
source(here::here("R", "0_setup.R"))
cpue_cfg <- cfg$CPUE %||% list()
cpue_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "cpue")
dir.create(cpue_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
engine <- cpue_cfg$engine %||% "sdmTMB"
```

The record frame has one row per **`r cpue_cfg$unit %||% "haul"`** with the columns `year`, `month`, `yday`, `vessel_id`, `vessel_length`, `catch` (kg), `effort` (e.g. traps or trawl hours), `lon`, `lat`, `depth`, and optional covariates (`soak`, `gear_spec`, `area`). Map the extract to these names in the next chunk; everything below reads them.

```{r load}
records <- readRDS(here::here(cpue_cfg$file))
# <- adapt: commercial data differ by source, country, period and fishery, so this mapping is
# bespoke to this extract (index-wise knowledge/cpue.md). Document each field's meaning, unit and
# valid years in ai/memory/. Illustration only, for one Norwegian ERS extract:
# records <- dplyr::transmute(records, year = fangstar, month = lubridate::month(starttidspunkt),
#   yday = lubridate::yday(starttidspunkt), vessel_id = rc, vessel_length = storste_lengde,
#   catch = rundvekt, effort = innsats, soak = varighet / 60, lon = stopp_lg, lat = stopp_lt,
#   depth = NA_real_)
required <- c("year", "month", "yday", "vessel_id", "catch", "effort", "lon", "lat")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(records))
if (length(missing_cols)) stop("Map these columns to the CPUE schema: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
if (!is.null(cpue_cfg$first_year)) records <- dplyr::filter(records, year >= cpue_cfg$first_year)
```

# Analysis

## Coverage of the landings

```{r, eval=!is.null(cpue_cfg$landings_file)}
#| label: tbl-cpue-reconcile
landings <- readRDS(here::here(cpue_cfg$landings_file))
knitr::kable(cpue_reconcile(records, landings), digits = 2,
             caption = "Logbook catch, landed catch (t) and coverage per year. A low or falling coverage means the index describes a small or shrinking part of the fleet.")
```

<!-- Describe the coverage and refer to @tbl-cpue-reconcile. -->

## Vessels and the core fleet

Vessels replaced under the same identifier get a new identifier from the year of the change. The filter cascade then applies the plausible ranges and the core-fleet thresholds from `config.yaml`; each step's share of records and catch is reported, and each threshold is varied in the sensitivity analysis.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cpue-filters
if ("vessel_length" %in% names(records)) records <- cpue_vessel_changes(records)
records <- cpue_vessel_activity(records)
range_step <- function(v, r) {
  lo <- r[[1]]; hi <- if (length(r) > 1) r[[2]] else NULL
  bquote(!is.na(.(as.name(v))) & .(as.name(v)) >= .(lo %||% -Inf) & .(as.name(v)) <= .(hi %||% Inf))
}
ranges <- cpue_cfg$ranges %||% list()
steps <- c(
  list("positive catch" = quote(catch > 0), "effort recorded" = quote(!is.na(effort) & effort > 0)),
  stats::setNames(lapply(names(ranges), function(v) range_step(v, ranges[[v]])),
                  paste(names(ranges), "in range")),
  list("vessel years active" = bquote(years_active >= .(cpue_cfg$min_years_active %||% 1)),
       "vessel records per year" = bquote(records_year >= .(cpue_cfg$min_records_year %||% 0)),
       "vessel records in total" = bquote(records_total >= .(cpue_cfg$min_records_total %||% 0)))
)
cascade <- cpue_filter_cascade(records, steps)
d <- cascade$data
knitr::kable(dplyr::mutate(cascade$log, catch = catch / 1000), digits = 3,
             caption = "Filter cascade: records, vessels and catch (t) retained after each step, and their share of all records.")
```

<!-- Describe the supported finding and refer to @tbl-cpue-filters. Explain any step that removes a large share of the catch. -->

## Exploration

```{r}
#| label: fig-cpue-fleet
#| fig-cap: "Records and active vessels per year in the selected data, and the vessels by years active. Fleet composition that changes over time is what the vessel effect must absorb."
fleet <- d |> dplyr::group_by(year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(records = dplyr::n(), vessels = dplyr::n_distinct(vessel_id), .groups = "drop")
cowplot::plot_grid(
  ggplot2::ggplot(fleet, ggplot2::aes(year, records)) + ggplot2::geom_col() +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Records"),
  ggplot2::ggplot(dplyr::distinct(d, year, vessel_id, years_active),
                  ggplot2::aes(year, fill = factor(years_active))) + ggplot2::geom_bar() +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Vessels", fill = "Years active"),
  ncol = 1, labels = "AUTO")
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-cpue-effort
#| fig-cap: "Catch against effort per record (log scales) with a smooth. The slope informs whether effort enters as an offset (slope 1) or as a covariate."
ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(effort, catch)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.1, size = 0.5) + ggplot2::geom_smooth() +
  ggplot2::scale_x_log10() + ggplot2::scale_y_log10() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Effort", y = "Catch (kg)")
```

Fishing positions are shown aggregated to grid cells, never as individual records.

```{r}
#| label: fig-cpue-coverage
#| fig-cap: "Records per 0.5° × 0.25° cell and year in the selected data."
cells <- d |>
  dplyr::mutate(lon_c = floor(lon * 2) / 2 + 0.25, lat_c = floor(lat * 4) / 4 + 0.125) |>
  dplyr::count(year, lon_c, lat_c)
ggplot2::ggplot(cells, ggplot2::aes(lon_c, lat_c, fill = n)) + ggplot2::geom_tile() +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~year) + ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "log10") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude", fill = "Records") + ggplot2::coord_quickmap()
```

## Model data and reference conditions

```{r model-data}
d <- d |>
  dplyr::mutate(vessel_id = factor(vessel_id), fyear = factor(year), log_effort = log(effort),
                yday_std = (yday - mean(yday)) / stats::sd(yday),
                vessel_year = factor(paste(vessel_id, year)))
if ("depth" %in% names(d) && any(is.finite(d$depth)))
  d$depth_std <- (d$depth - mean(d$depth, na.rm = TRUE)) / stats::sd(d$depth, na.rm = TRUE)
d <- sdmTMB::add_utm_columns(d, ll_names = c("lon", "lat"), utm_crs = cfg$CRS)   # X, Y in km
# Reference conditions: the configured values, else the median effort and season day.
reference <- utils::modifyList(list(log_effort = NULL, yday_std = NULL), cpue_cfg$reference %||% list())
if ("depth_std" %in% names(d)) reference$depth_std <- reference$depth_std %||% 0
offset_col <- if (identical(cpue_cfg$effort_treatment, "offset")) "log_effort" else NULL
```

## Model

The formulas are the starting point for this species; adapt the covariates and keep the structure: `0 + fyear`, effort, season and depth smooths, and a vessel random intercept. `config.yaml` `CPUE: engine` selects the engine (see `cpue-models.md`).

```{r formulas}
effort_term <- if (is.null(offset_col)) "log_effort + " else ""
depth_term <- if ("depth_std" %in% names(d)) " + s(depth_std, k = 4)" else ""
cpue_formula <- switch(engine,
  glmmTMB = stats::as.formula(paste0("catch ~ 0 + fyear + ", effort_term,
    "splines::ns(yday_std, df = 3)", if (nzchar(depth_term)) " + splines::ns(depth_std, df = 3)",
    if (!is.null(offset_col)) " + offset(log_effort)", " + (1 | vessel_id)")),
  mgcv = stats::as.formula(paste0("catch ~ fyear + ", effort_term, "s(yday_std, k = 4)", depth_term,
    if (!is.null(offset_col)) " + offset(log_effort)",
    " + s(X, Y, k = 40) + s(vessel_id, bs = 're')")),
  sdmTMB = stats::as.formula(paste0("catch ~ 0 + fyear + ", effort_term, "s(yday_std, k = 4)",
    depth_term, " + (1 | vessel_id)")),
  stop("CPUE engine must be glmmTMB, mgcv or sdmTMB."))
cpue_formula
fit_cpue <- function(formula, data) {
  switch(engine,
    glmmTMB = { ensure_packages("glmmTMB")
      glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula, data = data, family = Gamma(link = "log")) },
    mgcv = mgcv::bam(formula, data = data, family = Gamma(link = "log")),
    sdmTMB = sdmTMB::sdmTMB(formula, data = data, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
      mesh = sdmTMB::make_mesh(data, c("X", "Y"), cutoff = cpue_cfg$mesh_cutoff_km %||% 10),
      offset = offset_col, spatial = "on",
      spatiotemporal = cpue_cfg$spatiotemporal %||% "iid", time = "year"))
}
```

```{r fit, eval=params$refit_model}
fit <- fit_cpue(cpue_formula, d)
saveRDS(fit, file.path(cpue_dir, "cpue-fit.rds"))
```

```{r load-fit, eval=!params$refit_model}
fit <- readRDS(file.path(cpue_dir, "cpue-fit.rds"))
```

For the spatial engines the index is integrated over a fixed grid of the **fished domain**: the convex hull of the selected records, trimmed to their depth range. Cells nobody fished are not part of the index (see `cpue-models.md`, *The prediction domain*).

```{r grid}
hull <- sf::st_as_sf(d, coords = c("X", "Y"), crs = NA) |> sf::st_union() |> sf::st_convex_hull()
cell <- cpue_cfg$grid_km %||% 5
centres <- sf::st_make_grid(hull, cellsize = cell, what = "centers")
centres <- centres[lengths(sf::st_intersects(centres, hull)) > 0]
grid <- as.data.frame(sf::st_coordinates(centres))
grid_ll <- sf::st_coordinates(sf::st_transform(sf::st_sf(geometry = centres * 1000, crs = cfg$CRS), 4326))
grid$lon <- grid_ll[, 1]; grid$lat <- grid_ll[, 2]
if ("depth_std" %in% names(d)) {
  grid$depth <- ggOceanMaps::get_depth(grid[, c("lon", "lat")], bathy.style = "rc", bind = FALSE)
  grid <- grid[is.finite(grid$depth) & grid$depth >= min(d$depth, na.rm = TRUE) &
                 grid$depth <= max(d$depth, na.rm = TRUE), ]
  grid$depth_std <- (grid$depth - mean(d$depth, na.rm = TRUE)) / stats::sd(d$depth, na.rm = TRUE)
}
grid <- merge(grid, data.frame(year = sort(unique(d$year))))
grid$fyear <- factor(grid$year, levels = levels(d$fyear))
ref_row <- cpue_newdata(d, reference)[1, ]
for (v in names(reference)) grid[[v]] <- ref_row[[v]]
grid$vessel_id <- factor(NA, levels = levels(d$vessel_id))
```

## Index

```{r}
#| label: fig-cpue-index
#| fig-cap: "Standardised CPUE index (relative to its mean, with 95% interval) and nominal CPUE (ratio of sums, relative to its mean)."
index <- switch(engine,
  glmmTMB = cpue_year_index(fit, cpue_newdata(d, reference)),
  mgcv = cpue_gam_area_index(fit, grid, area = cell^2, exclude = "s(vessel_id)"),
  sdmTMB = cpue_sdm_index(fit, grid, area = cell^2, bias_correct = params$bias_correct))
saveRDS(index, file.path(cpue_dir, "cpue-index.rds"))
nominal <- cpue_nominal(d)
ggplot2::ggplot(index, ggplot2::aes(year, index)) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(ymin = index_lwr, ymax = index_upr), alpha = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_line(data = nominal, linetype = 2) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Relative CPUE")
```

<!-- Describe the supported finding and refer to @fig-cpue-index. Where nominal and standardised CPUE diverge, say which covariate or which shift of the fleet explains it. -->

## Selection

Drop-one candidates of the fixed effects, fitted to the same records (`model-selection.md`). The effort slope (covariate version) is reported beside the table: 1 means catch proportional to effort.

```{r, eval=params$run_selection}
#| label: tbl-cpue-selection
terms <- attr(stats::terms(cpue_formula), "term.labels")
fixed <- terms[!grepl("\\||bs = .re.|fyear", terms)]
candidates <- c(list("Full model" = cpue_formula), stats::setNames(lapply(fixed, function(tm)
  stats::update(cpue_formula, stats::as.formula(paste(". ~ . -", tm)))), paste("No", fixed)))
selection <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(candidates), function(nm) {
  f <- tryCatch(fit_cpue(candidates[[nm]], d), error = function(e) NULL)
  data.frame(model = nm, AIC = if (is.null(f)) NA_real_ else stats::AIC(f))
})) |> dplyr::mutate(deltaAIC = AIC - min(AIC, na.rm = TRUE)) |> dplyr::arrange(AIC)
knitr::kable(selection, digits = 1, caption = "Drop-one fixed-effect candidates on identical records, ordered by AIC.")
```

## Diagnostics

```{r}
#| label: tbl-cpue-dispersion
if (engine == "sdmTMB") print(sdmTMB::sanity(fit))
groups <- list(vessel = d$vessel_id, `vessel-year` = d$vessel_year,
               year = d$fyear)
if ("area" %in% names(d)) groups$`area-year` <- interaction(d$area, d$year)
knitr::kable(cpue_pearson_groups(fit, groups), digits = 3,
             caption = "Grouped residual dispersion (Pearson residuals summed by group, relative to the ungrouped variance). About 1 for independent records; above 1 for groups the model does not contain means correlated records and too narrow intervals.")
```

```{r, eval=engine == "glmmTMB" && requireNamespace("DHARMa", quietly = TRUE)}
#| label: tbl-cpue-dharma
knitr::kable(cpue_dharma_groups(fit, list(records = NULL, vessel = d$vessel_id,
                                           `vessel-year` = d$vessel_year)), digits = 3,
             caption = "Simulation-based (DHARMa) dispersion by group for the glmmTMB fit.")
```

<!-- Report sanity() and the grouped dispersion and refer to @tbl-cpue-dispersion (and @tbl-cpue-dharma). A vessel-year dispersion well above 1 calls for a (1 | vessel_year) term or the vessel bootstrap. -->

## Uncertainty: vessel bootstrap

```{r, eval=params$run_bootstrap}
#| label: fig-cpue-bootstrap
#| fig-cap: "Vessel bootstrap of the index: the model's interval (shaded) and the 2.5–97.5% range of the bootstrap indices (dashed)."
boot <- cpue_vessel_bootstrap(d, function(db) {
  f <- fit_cpue(cpue_formula, db)
  switch(engine,
    glmmTMB = cpue_year_index(f, cpue_newdata(db, reference)),
    mgcv = cpue_gam_area_index(f, grid, area = cell^2, exclude = "s(vessel_id)", nsim = 1),
    sdmTMB = cpue_sdm_index(f, grid, area = cell^2))
}, n_boot = cpue_cfg$bootstrap_n %||% 200)
saveRDS(boot, file.path(cpue_dir, "cpue-bootstrap.rds"))
boot_range <- boot |> dplyr::group_by(year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(lo = stats::quantile(index, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
                   hi = stats::quantile(index, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
ggplot2::ggplot(index, ggplot2::aes(year, index)) +
  ggplot2::geom_ribbon(ggplot2::aes(ymin = index_lwr, ymax = index_upr), alpha = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_line(data = boot_range, ggplot2::aes(y = lo), linetype = 2) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(data = boot_range, ggplot2::aes(y = hi), linetype = 2) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Relative CPUE")
```

## Sensitivity

Each run refits the selected model with one change: peeling the last or the first years, and cutting every year's data at the month the terminal-year data end (`CPUE: final_month`).

```{r, eval=params$run_sensitivity}
#| label: fig-cpue-sensitivity
#| fig-cap: "Index under retrospective peels (A), forward peels (B) and the final-month cut (C), each rescaled to its mean over the years it shares with the full model."
run_index <- function(db, label, panel) {
  f <- fit_cpue(cpue_formula, droplevels(db))
  i <- switch(engine,
    glmmTMB = cpue_year_index(f, cpue_newdata(droplevels(db), reference)),
    mgcv = cpue_gam_area_index(f, grid[grid$year %in% db$year, ], area = cell^2,
                               exclude = "s(vessel_id)", nsim = 1),
    sdmTMB = cpue_sdm_index(f, grid, area = cell^2))
  shared <- intersect(i$year, index$year)
  dplyr::mutate(i, relative = est / mean(est[year %in% shared]), run = label, panel = panel)
}
yrs <- sort(unique(d$year))
runs <- c(
  lapply(1:3, function(k) run_index(dplyr::filter(d, year <= max(yrs) - k), paste("to", max(yrs) - k), "A")),
  lapply(1:3, function(k) run_index(dplyr::filter(d, year >= min(yrs) + k), paste("from", min(yrs) + k), "B")),
  if (!is.null(cpue_cfg$final_month))
    list(run_index(dplyr::filter(d, month <= cpue_cfg$final_month),
                   paste("months 1 -", cpue_cfg$final_month), "C"))
)
sensitivity <- dplyr::bind_rows(runs)
saveRDS(sensitivity, file.path(cpue_dir, "cpue-sensitivity.rds"))
full <- dplyr::mutate(index, relative = index, run = "full model")
ggplot2::ggplot(sensitivity, ggplot2::aes(year, relative, colour = run)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_line(data = full, colour = "black", linewidth = 1, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                     ggplot2::aes(year, relative)) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Year", y = "Relative CPUE", colour = NULL)
```

<!-- Describe @fig-cpue-sensitivity: how far the terminal year moves, and whether the trend depends on the first years or the season cut. Vary the filter thresholds the same way. -->

## Export

```{r export}
source(here::here("R", "assessment_index_handoff.R"))
cpue_handoff <- build_assessment_index_handoff(
  list("Commercial CPUE" = dplyr::transmute(index, year, est = index, lwr = index_lwr,
                                            upr = index_upr, se)),
  "Commercial CPUE",
  list(units = "relative CPUE",
       uncertainty = list(column = "se", scale = "log", measure = "standard_error"),
       index_type = "commercial CPUE",
       timing = 0.5,   # <- set to the mid-season of the fishery as a fraction of the year
       spatial_scope = paste("fished domain of", cpue_cfg$source %||% "logbook", "records"),
       provenance = list(project = "index-wise", source = "{{SPECIES_SLUG}} CPUE report",
                         engine = engine, formula = paste(deparse(cpue_formula), collapse = ""))))
saveRDS(cpue_handoff, file.path(out_dir, "assessment-index-cpue.rds"))
```
